origin.rerun: sed -n '/def current_net_position_qty/,/^def /p' src/runtime/positions.py | grep -n 'treating as flat'  # present => still open

what: [AUD-20260927-CA-A02-net-position-read-failure-reads-flat] When the journal read fails (e.g. sqlite 'database is locked'), current_net_position_qty returns 0.0 ('treating as flat') and both open-position guards (has_open_trade_for_strategy, coordinator._has_open_position) return False, so an intent-mode package on an account that already holds the symbol is dispatched as a fresh full-size 'open' instead of noop/hold/increase. Proposed fix: Return Optional[float] (None = could not look) and have the coordinator refuse the account with reason net_position_unreadable; same for the two has-open helpers. (Tier 2; audit lanes do not enact fixes.)
